campaign_platform_points: Education: The campaign pledges to maintain and expand four semesters of free tuition for every Gavilan College student regardless of financial need, as part of a broader commitment to removing barriers to college completion.

Education: The candidate commits to setting policy that keeps community college accessible, provides quality programs and guidance, and removes barriers that hinder students from completing their education or career objectives.
Housing: The campaign states it has advanced a student housing plan at Gavilan College and is actively pursuing both state and private funding to make the approved plan a reality.

Jobs & labor: The candidate highlights achieving two consecutive two-year collective bargaining agreements with faculty, initiating the process for student workers to unionize, and raising wages for faculty, staff, and students while maintaining a strong financial reserve.

Education: The campaign credits itself with expanding dual enrollment opportunities that allow high school students to take college courses at their local campuses, improving academic pathways and course offerings.

Criminal justice & public safety: The candidate states he has championed stronger campus security at Gavilan College, along with upgraded technology and data infrastructure and long-overdue repairs to roads, buildings, sidewalks, and HVAC systems.

Government accountability & ethics: The candidate commits to fiscal accountability as a steward of public funds, ensuring taxpayer money directly supports classrooms and programs yield positive student outcomes, while advocating for resource equity so Gavilan receives its fair share.

Education: The campaign states it expanded access to food, transportation, counseling, and health services for students, and committed to partnering with large-scale companies and organizations to create student opportunities and strengthen enrollment and graduation rates.
